context: Run each mode at SF>=1 through the normal benchmark path with the correctness gate enabled; record results and any failures on this item. Live PostgreSQL is reachable via a container (note: Apple Containerization -p forwarding does not work - use the container IP, PG_DUCKLAKE_HOST). S3 needs a real bucket and credentials. Also settle whether remote-backed numbers are reproducible enough to keep w12's ranking-eligible decision, which the ADR says to revisit once scale runs exist.
description: The single unmet criterion keeping DuckLake at support_status=experimental, per docs/development/adr/adr-ducklake-maturity-and-publishability.md decision w11. Criteria 1, 2 and 4 are met (PR-lane coverage #1357; live PostgreSQL 18.4 + real-S3 runs 2026-07-30; server-side reuse/force verified). Criterion 3 is not: every DuckLake execution to date is SF=0.01 smoke, which exercises correctness but says nothing about behaviour at benchmark scale. Needed: a full TPC-H SF>=1 run on each of local, local_catalog_s3, postgres_catalog and postgres_catalog_s3, validated through the standard correctness gate. Without this the ADR names a blocker nobody tracks.

preserves.behavior: support_status stays experimental until every w11 criterion is met

verifications.command: <record the four run ids and correctness-gate outcomes on this item>
verifications.description: TPC-H SF>=1 completes and validates on all four deployment modes
verifications.expected: four green runs, one per deployment mode
